relationships.evidence_quote: suzetrigine achieved significant reductions in postoperative pain compared to placebo

key_findings: Suzetrigine selectively inhibits NaV1.8 with minimal off-target effects on NaV1.7 and NaV1.9.
In Phase 2 trials suzetrigine reduced postoperative pain versus placebo, comparable to hydrocodone/acetaminophen.
